## Startup sequence

Power command, stable rails, firmware startup, POST, boot-device selection, bootloader, operating system.

Record firmware vendor/version, CPU, RAM, storage, date/time, and boot order without changing unapproved settings. Explain the different jobs of POST, firmware, a bootloader, and an operating system.

The Main Quest uses a known-good machine. Predict possible symptoms for missing RAM, a missing boot drive, and wrong boot order, but do not create a fault. Teacher-prepared faults belong in [SQ02](sq02-fault-stations.qmd).

Submit the sequence diagram, firmware record, explanation, and normal reboot check.
